what: Author prismis-tui, prismis-cli and prismis-daemon Homebrew formulas under packaging/homebrew/ with a render script that fills url, sha256 and version for a release tag and generates prismis-cli's resources from cli/uv.lock; give cli/pyproject.toml an explicit hatchling [build-system]; lead the README Installation section with the brew commands.
why: Design: docs/work/homebrew-formulas/design.md. gh #48 stays open until the formulas are published to nickpending/homebrew-prismis for a tagged release and installed from the tap, an outward-facing release step run with the operator's go after this merges; this work order builds and proves the formulas from the tree.

criteria.given: a throwaway local tap made with `brew tap-new` holding the three formulas from packaging/homebrew/
criteria.when: `brew install --HEAD` and then `brew test` run for each formula, one at a time, each into a clean state
criteria.then: it fails if any install or test fails or if installing one pulls in another prismis formula; otherwise prismis provides bin/prismis, prismis-cli provides bin/prismis-cli and prismis-daemon provides bin/prismis-daemon, and each test passes

criteria.when: the render script generates prismis-cli's resources for macOS
criteria.then: it fails if a resource differs from the lock's sdist url and hash, a client-only dependency is missing, a [local]-only package or a Windows-only package (colorama) is included, or the committed formula's resources differ from the render; otherwise they match, and the test is shown red with one locked version changed

criteria.given: prismis-daemon installed from the local tap
criteria.when: `uv pip list` of its libexec environment is compared with `uv export --frozen --no-dev --no-emit-project` of daemon/uv.lock for macOS
criteria.then: it fails if any locked package is installed at a different version; otherwise every locked package matches

criteria.given: prismis-daemon installed from the local tap
criteria.when: its service definition is rendered (the launchd plist brew writes for the service block)
criteria.then: it fails if the plist does not run prismis-daemon with keep-alive and a log path under the brew prefix; otherwise it does, and a daemon started from that command with a ~/.config/prismis/.env holding OPENROUTER_API_KEY sees the variable

criteria.given: a tag name and that tag's source tarball
criteria.when: the render script fills the three formulas
criteria.then: it fails if url, sha256 or version is wrong in any formula, or if anything else in the formulas changes; otherwise only those three fields change

criteria.given: the three formulas' caveats and README.md
criteria.then: it fails if the client formulas' caveats omit the [remote] url and key step and the check command, the daemon's omit the OPENROUTER_API_KEY, context bootstrap, verify and brew services steps, or the README Installation section does not lead with the three brew commands; otherwise all are present
it fails on any failing check; otherwise its last line is `verify: PASS`

outOfScope: prismis-daemon downloads its wheels from PyPI at install time instead of shipping a bottle, so an install needs network access and takes as long as the torch download.
prismis-tui builds from source on each user's Mac, so installing it pulls Go as a build dependency.
Publishing to the tap is a release step run with the operator's go, not automatic on every merge.
Linux hosts such as cerebro keep make install; the formulas target macOS.
stakes: Each of prismis-tui, prismis-cli and prismis-daemon installs alone with `brew install --HEAD` from a local tap built from this tree, and its `brew test` passes.
prismis-cli's resources are generated from cli/uv.lock, and a test fails if the committed formula's resources differ from what the lock renders.
prismis-daemon installs the exact daemon/uv.lock versions: after install, every locked package in its libexec environment has its locked version.
prismis-daemon's service block produces a launchd plist that runs prismis-daemon, and the daemon started that way reads keys from ~/.config/prismis/.env.
The render script, given a tag and its tarball, writes url, sha256 and version into all three formulas and nothing else changes.
Each formula's caveats name its setup step, and the README leads with the brew commands.
